name: Trattoria da Enzo al 29
notes: Cacio e pepe as it should be. Unpretentious, perfect.

name: Osteria dell'Enoteca
notes: Exceptional bistecca fiorentina, thoughtful wine list, old-world Florentine atmosphere.

name: Bar Basso
notes: Birthplace of the Negroni Sbagliato. The Campari aperitivo hour here is an institution.

name: Russ & Daughters Café
notes: The perfect bagel with lox and schmear. A New York ritual not to be missed.

name: Taquería ReTox
notes: Surprisingly good tacos in Budapest. Carnitas are the move. Casual, fun, loud.

name: Koli Café
notes: The reason why it din't get a perfect hundred is that there is no such thing as absolute perfection. But this place is as close as it gets. The coffee is sublime, the atmosphere cozy, the people are nice and the barista knows how to handle a customer like myself. I have been there over 100 times and I am always happy to taste their newest speciality beans.
